standard-dialogue-aviansie-ghost-with-gh.npc: You! Which god do you serve?
The war! What side do you fight on?
No war? But I was fighting earlier today.

standard-dialogue-aviansie-ghost-with-gh.player: I hate to say it, but I don't think that's true. You're dead.

standard-dialogue-aviansie-ghost-with-gh.npc: Dead? That can't be! I am a loyal warrior of...
I... I don't know. I can't remember.
We came here to fight. But I don't know who for. It's like it was moments ago, but also a lifetime in the past.

standard-dialogue-aviansie-ghost-with-gh.player: Do you know who you were fighting against?

standard-dialogue-aviansie-ghost-with-gh.npc: No. We were here to claim something. To protect it. But everything else is unclear.
I'm sorry, this is all so confusing. I need some time to try and understand.

standard-dialogue-aviansie-ghost-with-gh.player: Well I hope it all works out for you. Good luck.

standard-dialogue-ork-ghost-with-ghostsp.npc: You wear cunning disguise. I see though. You flappy chicken! You die in name of Big High War God.

standard-dialogue-ork-ghost-with-ghostsp.player: There's no Big High War God here.

standard-dialogue-ork-ghost-with-ghostsp.npc: Lies! Big High War God use the shiny to kill the chickens! Now we clear up the rest!

standard-dialogue-ork-ghost-with-ghostsp.player: Sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I think this 'shiny' might have killed you as well.

standard-dialogue-ork-ghost-with-ghostsp.npc: Chicken play mind games, but I no fool. You die now!

standard-dialogue-ork-ghost-with-ghostsp.player: You know there's normally not this much talking before dying.
I think I'll leave you to it.
